item.title: MICHAEL CHAMBERLAIN: Good Riddance To EPA’s Endangerment Finding
item.description: Better late than never. With the announcement that the EPA will reverse its 2009 greenhouse gas endangerment finding under the Clean Air Act, the agency is righting a grievous wrong committed by the Obama administration.
